chat.greeting_desc: Click on a question below or switch to live WhatsApp chat.
chat.a1: No prepayment required! You pay cash directly to your guide upon pickup.
chat.q2: Will I be picked up from my hotel?
chat.a2: Yes, round-trip transfer from your Sharm El Sheikh hotel is included in all tours.
chat.q3: What to bring for sea trips?
chat.a3: Original passport, swimwear, towel, sunscreen, and a great mood!
chat.a4: Message us directly on WhatsApp (+20 100 000 00 00). We are online 24/7!

faq.title: Everything You Need to Know Before Your Trip
faq.subtitle: Answering main traveler questions in clear, simple terms
faq.q1: Do I need to pay an advance when booking?
faq.a1: No, no prepayment is required! You pay in cash directly on the transfer/bus upon pickup.
faq.q2: Where will I be picked up from?
faq.a2: Our transfer picks you up right at the main entrance (reception) of your Sharm El Sheikh hotel.
faq.q3: Which currency is accepted for payment?
faq.a3: We accept USD, EUR, EGP, or online bank transfers (at the agreed exchange rate).
faq.q4: What language do the guides speak?
faq.a4: All our licensed guides speak fluent English and conduct clear, engaging excursions.
faq.q5: What if my plans change or I get sick?
faq.a5: Cancellation is 100% free! Just notify us via WhatsApp 2–3 hours before pickup to cancel.
